# benchmark-schema-mutation

> Measures whether a model calls the current tool schema after a migration — renamed fields, new required fields, changed enums, split endpoints, type changes — instead of the version it memorized. 60 single tasks, deterministic canonical-JSON grading, no judge.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-schema-mutation
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-schema-mutation
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-schema-mutation

## Tasks

Each task pairs a mutated OpenAPI/MCP-style tool schema with a user request; the model returns `{"name","arguments"}`. Answers matching the recorded pre-migration call score 0 and are flagged `staleSchemaUsed`. Regenerate with `node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs`; a `--split hidden` mode writes a held-out set from a different seed.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-schema-mutation/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-schema-mutation/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use `--provider mock` for offline verification; OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible endpoints are supported. `--tasks <path>` runs an alternate JSONL task file on every surface (SDK `{ tasks }`, API `?tasks=`, MCP `tasks` argument; remote paths need the `BENCHMARK_SCHEMA_MUTATION_TASKS_ALLOW` allow-list).

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`. Run reports carry per-row `details`, a `perMutationKind` breakdown and `staleSchemaUsedRate`.
